en:
<CLT=cltMIND>When we returned from the courtroom,
the area was already blanketed in darkness.

For now...we should rest. To me, that
seems the most rational course of action.

Yeah... My brain's outta juice from
going full-throttle all day.
Like you even have a brain to use!

Anyway, this killing game is over!
I won't allow it to go on!

It'll be fine. As long as we listen to Atua,
we'll all be just fine.

What's wrong, Gonta?
Why're you staring up at the sky?

It's just...even when all this bad stuff
happens, stars are always so pretty.

But stars here different.
Not the same ones Gonta used to.

Different? Do you mean...the position
of the stars?

Yeah... Gonta looking, but no can find star
he remembers.

But...why? Were we taken somewhere
far away?
<CLT=cltMIND>Far away...?

Hey, let's all head back already.
I'm wiped out.
Ah, yeah...

Oh, hold on.
I have to tell you guys something.

What now?
Like I said, I'm wiped out.

Now now, it won't take that long,
so just listen to what I have to say.
Well then? What is it that you have to say?

Everyone seems to be treating me like
some kinda compulsive liar...

But that's ridiculous! There's a way worse
liar than me in our group!
A liar worse than you?
...I'm talking about Maki.
What?
What do you mean, Maki's a liar?

Maki admitted it during the class trial,
remember?

Ryoma wanted her to show him his <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>
cuz he was looking for a reason to live.

But that wasn't the whole story...
Ryoma was blackmailing you, wasn't he, Maki?
B-Blackmail?

Ryoma just so happened to discover
Maki's <CLT=cltSTRONG>true identity<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

So he used that to blackmail her.
I bet he said something like...

"If you don't show me my <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltNORMAL>, I'll
tell everyone what you really are."

That's why Maki didn't want us to know she
met with Ryoma.

She wanted to keep her <CLT=cltSTRONG>true identity<CLT=cltNORMAL> a secret!
That's why she kept quiet until the last minute!

Wh-Why you... What shit are you making
up now? Maki's <CLT=cltSTRONG>true identity<CLT=cltNORMAL>? What-

Nee-heehee, I've known Maki's <CLT=cltSTRONG>true
identity<CLT=cltNORMAL> the whole time.

<CLT=cltMIND>For a moment there,
I thought Maki had disappeared...
<CLT=cltMIND>She moved so fast...

Y-Y'know...th-this is an interesting
t-turn of events...

B-But, would you really...k-kill me in front
of everyone...?
H-Hey, Maki! What the hell is going on?

Y-Yeah...you can probably...snap my 
neck like a twig right now...

But that's...not your style...
Y-You would rather...kill from the shadows...
Right...Miss <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Assassin<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
